'''Derellium wine''' was a type of [[Wine/Legends|wine]] from the planet [[Derellium]]. It was also a codeword used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Terri Karl]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] to identify herself to other Rebel agents.
